attachment.mechanism: hermes chat native --image attachment in one isolated persistent tool-disabled session
attachment.oneImageExceptionReason: Focused one-image turns preserve clean tuple-level attachment auditing while one persistent session is resumed for all eight assets.

orientation.basis: The prominent title, body, lower label, and 2+ marker have level horizontal baselines and read left-to-right. The background display is oblique in scene perspective but does not require rotating the full image.

blindPixelObservations: Portrait frame filled with densely layered dark blue, black, magenta, red, and orange structures, including many looping cables and angular panel-like surfaces.
A large luminous rectangular display occupies the upper-middle area and is tilted slightly in perspective. Its face grades from cyan-blue at left to pink-red at right.
The display contains several rows and columns of very small white alphanumeric-looking marks. White starburst fractures and dark red splatter-like forms obscure portions of the display face.

Strong orange-white illumination enters from the right edge. Additional equipment-like forms, narrow label-like strips, and tiny character-like clusters occur around the left and right background margins.
A compact blue-white composite glyph followed by 2+ is centered above the main title plaque in the lower-middle area.

The lower region contains a wide near-black title plaque overlapping a larger translucent dark body panel. Thin bronze-orange outlines, stepped corners, projecting tabs, and mirrored diagonal accents define the frame.
The title is one centered uppercase line. The body is arranged as three centered mixed-case lines, with an orange uppercase line centered near the bottom.

The orange diagonal side accents are physically continuous with the panel frame. The display fractures, splatter, cables, and equipment retain irregular pictorial textures rather than isolated flat-symbol boundaries.

iconMorphology.location: Lower-middle center, directly left of 2+ and immediately above ESSENTIAL DATA.
iconMorphology.outerShape: Unenclosed composite consisting of approximately three nested horizontal elliptical rings beneath a small vertically symmetric solid-white upright form. The upright form has a rounded cap, narrow neck, broad upper sides, paired short lateral projections, a tapering center, and two lower projections.
iconMorphology.internalMarks: No facial or letter-like mark is visible in the rounded cap. Dark negative gaps separate the lateral projections from the central body and divide the lower pair. The elliptical base has cyan rims, dark-blue interiors, and visible gaps between successive rings.
iconMorphology.neighboringText: 2+ immediately to the right; ESSENTIAL DATA directly below.
iconMorphology.closestPlausibleAlternative: A pawn-, bottle-, or plume-like upright marker resting on ripple-like ovals.
iconMorphology.visibleDiscriminator: The upper element is a discrete rounded cap above bilateral side and split lower projections, rather than a pointed or continuously tapering contour.

proposedClassification.componentType: Printed MISSION TASK component titled ESSENTIAL DATA
proposedClassification.basisFromPixelsOnly: The pixels show a framed title plaque and body panel, the explicit title ESSENTIAL DATA, one three-line instruction, a 2+ marker beside an unlabeled glyph, and the lower-center label MISSION TASK.

readConfidence.materialText: Very high for 2+, ESSENTIAL DATA, all three main body lines, and MISSION TASK. The body visibly reads with Data token without an article before Data. Confidence is very low for all background microtext.
readConfidence.punctuation: Very high for the plus sign after 2 and the full stop after Lander; punctuation within the illegible or clipped background text is unresolved.
readConfidence.iconMorphology: High for the concentric blue rings and overall white silhouette; medium-high for the exact separation of the small lateral and lower projections because glow softens their edges.

classificationConfidence.componentFamily: High for a portrait card-like printed component based solely on the framed title-and-body layout.
classificationConfidence.exactComponent: Medium: the literal MISSION TASK and ESSENTIAL DATA label-title pairing is clear, but no external canonical identity is asserted.

uncertainties: The luminous display contains substantial material microtext, but its small size, oblique perspective, glare, fractures, and splatter prevent exact character-level transcription.
The faint diagonal sequence behind the body panel is partly occluded and cannot be completed from the visible strokes.
The blue-white glyph's semantic identity is not established by 2+; its white element could visually resemble a rounded upright figure, pawn, bottle, or plume-like marker.
The large luminous display, fractures, splatter, cables, and background equipment are treated as pictorial scene elements rather than promoted to functional symbols.
The mirrored orange panel-side marks appear border-integrated and are not promoted to functional symbols.
MISSION TASK occurs once at lower center; it is represented in both typeLine and lowerCenter to encode its apparent role and visible position, not as two separate printed instances.
